purpose: Define minimal recovery/bootstrap web path so Expose can be repaired without making the recovery surface a privileged semantic owner or AccessCore bypass.

topics.name: Expose Bootstrap and Recovery
topics.purpose: Define minimal recovery/bootstrap web path so Expose can be repaired without making the recovery surface a privileged semantic owner or AccessCore bypass.

semantics.bootstrap_rule: Recovery surface is explicitly identified and minimal.
semantics.authority_rule: Recovery path still obeys applicable local IAM/AccessCore/bootstrap authority semantics.
semantics.self_host_rule: Editor self-hosting may recover from a known-good definition/copy without mutating the only active definition in place.
semantics.asset_rule: Recovery may use minimal embedded/static assets without creating parallel canonical ownership.
semantics.failure_rule: Broken primary Editor/site does not imply unrestricted recovery access.
semantics.activation_rule: Recovered candidate still validates before activation.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: recovery definition becomes separate authority model

references.purpose: Recovery uses explicit validated rollback/activation semantics.
